subject: Consolidated Phase 6 concurrency + build fixes replacing PR chain #20/#21/#22
summary: Consolidated all three PRs (#20 base fixes, #21 mutable m_active, #22 atomic m_mode) into a single branch against main. Fixes: (1) OTOIManager.h — m_active is now mutable std::atomic<bool>, m_mode is now mutable std::atomic<EnforcementMode>, added #include <atomic>; (2) OTOIManager.cpp safeHonor() — m_mode.store(relaxed) before m_active.store(release); getStatus() — m_active.load(acquire) then m_mode.load(relaxed); (3) Sleepwalker CMakeLists.txt — replaced hardcoded /home/joshd path with ENV{VCPKG_ROOT} per DECISIONS.md §4. Fully resolves both CodeRabbit Critical comments from PR #20 (compilation failure + data race on m_mode).
next_action: Review and merge — this replaces the 3-PR dependency chain with a single PR against main. After merge, Phase 6 ASFDK umbrella composition can proceed (ASFDK.cpp validateInteraction calls getStatus safely).
